title: Photocatalytic CO2 reduction to methanol: from mechanistic insights to reactor design integration
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23295-23313

Bridging micro-scale catalyst mechanisms with macro-scale reactor engineering, this review integrates active site design, multiphase microreactors, and photothermal management to advance industrial photocatalytic methanol synthesis.
